# lv24-opencode-consilium

> A council of AI experts for OpenCode: four expert agents (`arch`, `ux`, `ba`, `sec`) answer in parallel on different models, then a chair model synthesizes one plan. CLI, MCP server, native OpenCode V2 plugin and library API. Free-model bootstrap included.

Version: 1.9.0 · License: MIT · Node: >= 18 · Runtime dependencies: none

## Install

- `npm install -g lv24-opencode-consilium`
- `npx -y lv24-opencode-consilium --help`
- Container: `docker pull ghcr.io/levapveeskela/lv24-opencode-consilium:1.9.0`
- Requires the OpenCode CLI (`npm install -g opencode-ai`), authenticated; V1 or V2.

## Commands

- `consilium doctor` — environment, config, agents and model diagnostics.
- `consilium init --free [--dry-run] [--force] [--no-verify] [--native-v2]` — discover, rank, probe and write free models.
- `consilium models [--available] [--verify] [--limit N] [--refresh] [--json]` — ranked free models.
- `consilium [options] "<task>"` — run the council; `-f json` prints one JSON document on stdout.
- `consilium mcp [--install] [--global]` — stdio MCP server or config registration.
- `consilium watch [--debounce <ms>] [task]` — rerun on file changes.
- `consilium hooks install|uninstall` — managed git pre-commit review hook.
- `consilium --replay <id>` / `consilium --diff-runs <a> <b>` — rerun or compare saved artifacts.
- `consilium baseline accept|prune` — manage `.consilium/baseline.json`.
- `consilium eval [--fixtures <dir>] [--json] [--fail-under <pct>] [--max-cost <usd>]` — deterministic planted-bug suite.
- `consilium history [--limit N] [--json]` / `consilium stats [--json] [--html <file>]` — recent runs, success rate, p50/p95, cost, per-model errors.
- `consilium presets [--json]` — built-in and custom presets.
- `--deadline <ms>` — cap the expert phase; partial synthesis with `metadata.deadline`.
- `--local-only` — require explicit local models; `models --local` / `--probe-local`.
- `consilium init --local [--dry-run] [--force]` — probe Ollama/LM Studio and write a `localOnly` config.
- `--rounds <1|2>` — second anonymized peer-review round; `metadata.debate`.
- `consilium audit --since <ref> [--dry-run] [--fail-on <severity>]` — review `<ref>...HEAD` end-to-end.
- `--report sarif --report-file report.sarif` — SARIF 2.1.0 for code scanning (findings required).
- `consilium eval --compare-rounds` / `--rounds 2` — compare single-pass vs debate catch/FP/latency/cost.
- Scheduling recipes: docs/scheduling.md (cron, Task Scheduler, launchd, GitHub Actions).
- `--context <off|auto>` — add changed files, rules, tests and commits to the task.
- `consilium models --reliability` — per-model success/latency table.

## Findings and gate

- `--findings` — experts/chair return a fenced JSON block with `findings[]` and `rejected[]`.
- `metadata.findings` = `{ items, counts, rejected, parseErrors }`; findings are deduped by fingerprint (plus fuzzy paraphrases), max severity, `contested` when rejected.
- `--fail-on <severity>` — exit `3` when new findings reach the threshold.
- Baseline: `.consilium/baseline.json` via `consilium baseline accept|prune`; accepted fingerprints are ignored by the gate.

## Machine contract

- stdout: data only. stderr: progress and logs.
- JSON mode: `consilium -f json "<task>"` → result + `metadata` (models, usage, cost, consensus, artifacts, errorCode).
- Models JSON: `consilium models --json`.
- Exit codes: `0` success, `1` run failed, `2` usage error, `3` policy/eval gate failed.
- Typed errors: `RATE_LIMITED`, `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`, `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `AGENT_NOT_FOUND`, `COST_LIMIT`, `TIMEOUT`.
- Cost cap: `--max-cost <usd>`; when exceeded before the chair, a partial result with `errorCode: COST_LIMIT` is returned.
- Sessions: `--session <id>`; each agent gets `ses_<base>-<agent>`, the chair continues the base session.
- State: files under `.consilium/runs/<id>/` (`run.json`, `report.md`, `experts/<agent>.md`); no daemon, no database.
- Deadline: `--deadline <ms>` → `metadata.deadline = { limitMs, hit, completed, missing }`; zero completed experts → `errorCode: DEADLINE`.
- Privacy: `--local-only` requires an explicit local provider (`ollama`, `lmstudio`, `llamacpp`, `vllm`) for every agent; otherwise the run is rejected before spawning.
- Debate: `--rounds 2` → `metadata.debate = { rounds, participants, changed }`; round 2 doubles model calls and is skipped on low expert count, deadline or cost limit.

## MCP

- Command: `npx -y lv24-opencode-consilium mcp` (stdio JSON-RPC 2.0).
- Tools: `consilium_run`, `consilium_list_agents`, `consilium_free_models`, `consilium_doctor`, `consilium_init_free`.
- `consilium_init_free` is dry-run unless `"apply": true`; `consilium_run` streams progress with a `progressToken`.

## OpenCode slash command

- `/council <task>` — `.opencode/commands/council.md`; asks the agent to call the V2 plugin tool `consilium.run` (falling back to MCP `consilium_run`). Requires the plugin or MCP server to be registered.

## GitHub Action

- `.github/actions/consilium` — composite action; runs `--diff --base --report pr --fail-on <level>`, posts/updates one PR comment with `<!-- consilium:report -->`. Guide: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-opencode-consilium/blob/master/docs/github-action.md

## Evaluation

- `eval/fixtures/` — ten planted-bug fixtures (`task.md`, `changes.diff`, `expected.json`); deterministic claim matching, no LLM judge. Format: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-opencode-consilium/blob/master/eval/README.md

## Configuration

- Discovery order: `consilium.config.json`, `consilium.json`, `.consiliumrc`, `.consiliumrc.json`.
- OpenCode config: `opencode.json(c)`, `.opencode/opencode.json(c)`, parent directories, `~/.config/opencode`.
- Schema: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-opencode-consilium/blob/master/schema/config.schema.json
- Example: https://github.com/LevapVeeskela/lv24-opencode-consilium/blob/master/consilium.config.example.json
